class.name: NetwQuantizeTransform3D
class.brief_description: [NetwQuantize] that composes [Transform3D] from origin, rotation, and optional scale quantizers.
class.description: [member origin_quantizer] writes [member Transform3D.origin]. [member rotation_quantizer] writes [method Basis.get_rotation_quaternion]. [member scale_quantizer] writes local [method Basis.get_scale] when present. Shear is not encoded. A fresh instance already carries an origin and a rotation quantizer, so it encodes without any configuration. A transform whose parts were never declared would otherwise write nothing and decode to identity. [codeblock] var q := NetwQuantizeTransform3D.new() q.origin_quantizer = NetwQuantizeFixed.new() q.rotation_quantizer = NetwQuantizeQuaternion.new() [/codeblock]

members.member: Quantizer for [member Transform3D.origin]. Defaults to a [NetwQuantizeFixed].
Quantizer for [method Basis.get_rotation_quaternion]. Defaults to a [NetwQuantizeQuaternion].
Optional quantizer for [method Basis.get_scale]. Left unset, scale is not encoded and decodes as one.
